examples.en: Both sides agreed to a ceasefire after weeks of talks.
examples.zh: 雙方在談判數週後同意停火。

examples.en: The ceasefire gave families time to return home safely.
examples.zh: 停火讓家庭有時間平安返家。

examples.en: Leaders hope the ceasefire will last until the winter ends.
examples.zh: 領袖們希望停火能持續到冬天結束。

examples.en: She is a celebrated author known around the world.
examples.zh: 她是享譽全球的著名作家。

examples.en: The celebrated chef opened a new restaurant downtown.
examples.zh: 這位著名的主廚在市中心開了一家新餐廳。

examples.en: Our town is celebrated for its beautiful old bridge.
examples.zh: 我們的小鎮以美麗的古橋聞名。

examples.en: We celebrated my sister's birthday at a small café.
examples.zh: 我們在一家小咖啡館慶祝我姊姊的生日。

examples.en: The whole class celebrated after the final exam ended.
examples.zh: 期末考結束後，全班都在慶祝。

examples.en: They celebrated their tenth anniversary with a trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 他們以一趟日本之旅慶祝結婚十週年。

examples.en: We keep potatoes and onions in the cellar.
examples.zh: 我們把馬鈴薯和洋蔥存放在地窖裡。

examples.en: The old house has a cool, dark cellar.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有個涼爽昏暗的地下室。

examples.en: He took a bottle of wine from the cellar for dinner.
examples.zh: 他從酒窖拿了一瓶酒來配晚餐。

examples.en: She has played the cello since she was eight.
examples.zh: 她從八歲就開始拉大提琴。

examples.en: The cello sounds deep and warm in a small hall.
examples.zh: 在小廳裡，大提琴的聲音低沉而溫暖。

examples.en: My brother carries his cello to school every Monday.
examples.zh: 我哥哥每週一都把大提琴帶去學校。

examples.en: The teacher challenged us to solve the puzzle in five minutes.
examples.zh: 老師要我們挑戰在五分鐘內解開這道謎題。

examples.en: Nobody challenged his decision at the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議上沒有人質疑他的決定。

examples.en: She challenged her cousin to a game of chess.
examples.zh: 她向表哥下戰帖，要和他下一盤西洋棋。

examples.en: The school has special programs for physically challenged students.
examples.zh: 學校為身心有障礙的學生提供特殊課程。

examples.en: Many small shops are financially challenged this year.
examples.zh: 今年許多小店都面臨財務困難。

examples.en: He felt challenged by the difficult new project.
examples.zh: 他覺得這個困難的新專案很有挑戰性。

examples.en: The young challenger beat the champion in three sets.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的挑戰者以三盤擊敗了冠軍。

examples.en: Our company faces a new challenger in the phone market.
examples.zh: 我們公司在手機市場面臨新的挑戰者。

examples.en: The challenger will play the final game on Saturday.
examples.zh: 挑戰者將在星期六進行決賽。

senses.zh: 具挑戰性的；困難但有趣的

examples.en: This math test was challenging but fair.
examples.zh: 這次數學考試有難度，但很公平。

examples.en: She took a challenging job at a foreign company.
examples.zh: 她在一家外商公司找了一份具挑戰性的工作。

examples.en: It was a challenging hike for beginners.
examples.zh: 對初學者來說，這是一趟有挑戰性的健行。

examples.en: He is challenging the decision in court.
examples.zh: 他正在法庭上對這項決定提出質疑。

examples.en: They are challenging each other to a swimming race.
examples.zh: 他們正互相挑戰比賽游泳。

examples.en: Students are challenging the old rules about uniforms.
examples.zh: 學生們正在質疑有關制服的舊規定。

examples.en: My lips are chapped from the cold wind.
examples.zh: 我的嘴唇被冷風吹得乾裂。

examples.en: Put some cream on your chapped hands before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前在你乾裂的手上擦點乳霜。

examples.en: His cheeks were red and chapped after the ski trip.
examples.zh: 滑雪旅行後，他的臉頰又紅又乾裂。

examples.en: We cooked the fish over charcoal at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊用木炭烤魚。

examples.en: The art student drew a portrait with charcoal.
examples.zh: 這位美術系學生用炭筆畫了一幅肖像。

examples.en: She wore a charcoal jacket to the interview.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件炭灰色外套去面試。

examples.en: The museum has a model of an ancient chariot.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有一輛古代戰車的模型。

examples.en: Two horses pulled the chariot around the track.
examples.zh: 兩匹馬拉著戰車繞著賽道跑。

examples.en: In the movie, the hero rides a golden chariot.
examples.zh: 電影裡，主角駕著一輛金色馬車。

examples.en: The school club wrote a charter with clear rules.
examples.zh: 學校社團寫了一份規則明確的章程。

examples.en: The city received its charter in the year 1700.
examples.zh: 這座城市在一七〇〇年獲得特許狀。

examples.en: We booked a charter for the whole class trip.
examples.zh: 我們為全班旅行包了一趟包機。

senses.zh: 包租(船、飛機等)；特許設立

examples.en: They chartered a boat to see the whales.
examples.zh: 他們包了一艘船去看鯨魚。

examples.en: Our travel agency can charter a bus for the group.
examples.zh: 我們的旅行社可以為團體包租一輛遊覽車。

examples.en: The government chartered a new bank last year.
examples.zh: 政府去年特許設立了一家新銀行。

senses.zh: 閒聊；喋喋不休；嘰嘰喳喳聲

examples.en: The classroom was full of chatter before the bell rang.
examples.zh: 上課鈴響前，教室裡充滿了閒聊聲。

examples.en: I could hear the chatter of birds outside.
examples.zh: 我聽得到外面鳥兒的嘰嘰喳喳聲。

examples.en: Their endless chatter made it hard to study.
examples.zh: 他們沒完沒了的聊天聲讓人很難讀書。

examples.en: The children chattered all the way to the zoo.
examples.zh: 孩子們一路上都嘰嘰喳喳聊到動物園。

examples.en: Her teeth chattered in the cold water.
examples.zh: 她的牙齒在冷水中不停打顫。

examples.en: Stop chattering and finish your homework.
examples.zh: 別再閒聊了，把功課寫完。

examples.en: He wrote a check from his checkbook to pay the rent.
examples.zh: 他從支票簿撕下一張支票來付房租。

examples.en: My grandfather still keeps a checkbook in his desk.
examples.zh: 我爺爺書桌裡還放著一本支票簿。

examples.en: She forgot her checkbook, so she paid by card.
examples.zh: 她忘了帶支票簿，所以改用卡付款。

examples.en: She checked her bag twice before leaving home.
examples.zh: 她出門前把包包檢查了兩次。

examples.en: The doctor checked his heartbeat carefully.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細檢查了他的心跳。

examples.en: I checked the box next to my name.
examples.zh: 我在自己名字旁的方框打了勾。

examples.en: He wore a checked shirt to the picnic.
examples.zh: 他穿著格子襯衫去野餐。

examples.en: The checked tablecloth made the kitchen look cheerful.
examples.zh: 格子桌巾讓廚房看起來很愉快。

examples.en: My mother bought a checked scarf for me.
examples.zh: 我媽媽買了一條格子圍巾給我。

examples.en: Add one red chilli to make the soup spicy.
examples.zh: 加一根紅辣椒讓湯變辣。

examples.en: He cannot eat chilli because it hurts his stomach.
examples.zh: 他不能吃辣椒，因為會讓他胃痛。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its chilli sauce.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以辣椒醬聞名。

examples.en: The carpenter used a chisel to shape the wood.
examples.zh: 木匠用鑿子把木頭修整成形。

examples.en: He tapped the chisel gently with a hammer.
examples.zh: 他用鎚子輕輕敲打鑿子。

examples.en: A sharp chisel makes the work much easier.
examples.zh: 一把鋒利的鑿子能讓工作輕鬆許多。

examples.en: The artist chiseled a face into the stone.
examples.zh: 藝術家在石頭上鑿出一張臉。

examples.en: Workers chisel the old tiles off the floor.
examples.zh: 工人們把舊瓷磚從地板上鑿掉。

examples.en: He chiseled his name into the wooden bench.
examples.zh: 他把自己的名字刻在木頭長椅上。

examples.en: Chuck the old magazines in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 把舊雜誌丟進資源回收桶。

examples.en: He chucked his bag onto the sofa and sat down.
examples.zh: 他把背包往沙發上一扔，然後坐下。

examples.en: She chucked the baby under the chin and smiled.
examples.zh: 她輕拍寶寶的下巴並微笑。

examples.en: We bought chuck for the beef stew.
examples.zh: 我們買了牛頸肉來燉牛肉。

examples.en: Tighten the chuck before you start the drill.
examples.zh: 開始鑽孔前先鎖緊夾頭。

examples.en: The butcher cut a nice piece of chuck for us.
examples.zh: 肉販為我們切了一塊漂亮的牛頸肉。

examples.en: He chuckled when he read the funny note.
examples.zh: 他讀到那張有趣的紙條時輕輕笑了起來。

examples.en: The audience chuckled at the clown's tricks.
examples.zh: 觀眾被小丑的把戲逗得輕笑。

examples.en: My grandfather chuckles every time he hears that song.
examples.zh: 我爺爺每次聽到那首歌都會輕笑。

examples.en: She gave a soft chuckle and shook her head.
examples.zh: 她輕輕笑了一聲並搖搖頭。

examples.en: There was a chuckle from the back of the room.
examples.zh: 房間後方傳來一聲輕笑。

examples.en: His joke got a chuckle from everyone.
examples.zh: 他的笑話讓每個人都輕笑了一下。

examples.en: The circumference of the circle is about thirty centimeters.
examples.zh: 這個圓的周長大約是三十公分。

examples.en: Students learned how to measure the circumference of a ball.
examples.zh: 學生們學習如何測量球的周長。

examples.en: The circumference of the lake is nearly five kilometers.
examples.zh: 這座湖的周長將近五公里。

examples.en: He used a clamp to hold the board in place.
examples.zh: 他用夾鉗把木板固定住。

examples.en: The bike has a small clamp on the seat.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的座墊上有個小固定夾。

examples.en: Please bring a clamp from the toolbox.
examples.zh: 請從工具箱拿一個夾鉗過來。

examples.en: Clamp the paper to the table so it won't move.
examples.zh: 把紙夾在桌上，這樣它就不會移動。

examples.en: She clamped her hand over her mouth.
examples.zh: 她用手緊緊摀住嘴巴。

examples.en: The mechanic clamped the pipe before cutting it.
examples.zh: 技師在切斷管子前先把它夾住。

examples.en: The whole clan gathered for the New Year dinner.
examples.zh: 全族的人都聚在一起吃年夜飯。

examples.en: Each clan in the village had its own traditions.
examples.zh: 村裡每個氏族都有自己的傳統。

examples.en: My uncle is the oldest man in our clan.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是我們家族裡年紀最大的男性。

examples.en: Cleanse your face gently with warm water.
examples.zh: 用溫水輕輕清潔你的臉。

examples.en: The doctor cleansed the wound before covering it.
examples.zh: 醫生在包紮前先把傷口洗淨。

examples.en: A short walk can help cleanse your mind.
examples.zh: 散個短步能幫助淨化心靈。

examples.en: The class organized a cleanup of the school yard.
examples.zh: 全班籌辦了校園庭院的清掃活動。

examples.en: After the party, the cleanup took two hours.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，清理花了兩個小時。

examples.en: The city started a river cleanup this spring.
examples.zh: 市政府今年春天展開了河川清理工作。

senses.zh: 林間空地；清除；票據交換

examples.en: We set up our tent in a small clearing.
examples.zh: 我們在一小塊林間空地搭起帳篷。

examples.en: The clearing of snow took the workers all morning.
examples.zh: 清除積雪花了工人整個早上。

examples.en: The bank handles the clearing of checks every day.
examples.zh: 銀行負責處理支票的交換作業。

examples.en: She is clearing the table after dinner.
examples.zh: 她正在晚餐後收拾餐桌。

examples.en: Workers are clearing the road after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後，工人們正在清理道路。

examples.en: He is clearing his throat before the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演講前清了清喉嚨。

examples.en: She clenched her fists and tried to stay calm.
examples.zh: 她握緊拳頭，努力保持冷靜。

examples.en: He clenched his teeth during the long exam.
examples.zh: 漫長的考試期間，他一直咬緊牙關。

examples.en: The child clenched the toy tightly in her hand.
examples.zh: 小女孩把玩具緊緊握在手裡。

examples.en: Our team clinched the title with a late goal.
examples.zh: 我們隊以一記尾聲進球確定了冠軍。

examples.en: She clinched the deal after a short meeting.
examples.zh: 她在一場簡短會議後敲定了這筆交易。

examples.en: A strong interview helped him clinch the job.
examples.zh: 一場出色的面試幫助他拿到了這份工作。

examples.en: The bank is closed on Sundays.
examples.zh: 銀行星期日休息。

examples.en: Keep the windows closed during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間請把窗戶關好。

examples.en: The road is closed because of construction.
examples.zh: 這條路因施工而封閉。

examples.en: She closed the door quietly behind her.
examples.zh: 她輕輕地把門關上。

examples.en: The store closed early because of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 商店因颱風提早打烊。

examples.en: He closed his eyes and listened to the music.
examples.zh: 他閉上眼睛聽音樂。

examples.en: She found a four-leaf clover in the garden.
examples.zh: 她在花園裡找到一株四葉幸運草。

examples.en: Bees love the white clover growing near the path.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂喜歡長在小徑旁的白三葉草。

examples.en: Farmers plant clover to feed their cows.
examples.zh: 農夫種植苜蓿來餵牛。

examples.en: The little boy clutched his mother's hand.
examples.zh: 小男孩緊抓著媽媽的手。

examples.en: She clutched her bag as she walked through the crowd.
examples.zh: 她穿過人群時緊抓著她的包包。

examples.en: He clutched the rail to keep from falling.
examples.zh: 他緊抓著欄杆以免跌倒。

senses.zh: 離合器；手拿包；關鍵時刻

examples.en: Press the clutch before you change gears.
examples.zh: 換檔之前要先踩離合器。

examples.en: She carried a small silver clutch to the party.
examples.zh: 她帶了一個銀色小手拿包去派對。

examples.en: The striker is calm in the clutch.
examples.zh: 這位前鋒在關鍵時刻很冷靜。

examples.en: We drove along the coastal road all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午沿著海岸公路開車。

examples.en: Many coastal towns depend on tourism.
examples.zh: 許多沿海城鎮依靠觀光維生。

examples.en: Coastal areas often get strong winds in autumn.
examples.zh: 沿海地區秋天常常有強風。

examples.en: The pilot invited the boy to see the cockpit.
examples.zh: 機師邀請那個男孩參觀駕駛艙。

examples.en: Many switches covered the walls of the cockpit.
examples.zh: 駕駛艙的牆面布滿了許多開關。

examples.en: The race driver climbed into the cockpit and fastened his belt.
examples.zh: 賽車手爬進駕駛座並繫好安全帶。

examples.en: A butterfly slowly came out of the cocoon.
examples.zh: 一隻蝴蝶慢慢從繭裡出來。

examples.en: The worm spun a cocoon on the branch.
examples.zh: 那隻蟲在樹枝上吐絲結繭。

examples.en: She wrapped herself in a warm cocoon of blankets.
examples.zh: 她把自己裹在溫暖的毯子裡。

examples.en: Parents often cocoon their children from bad news.
examples.zh: 父母常常讓孩子與壞消息隔絕。

examples.en: He cocooned himself in a thick coat.
examples.zh: 他把自己裹在一件厚外套裡。

examples.en: The soft sofa cocooned her while she read.
examples.zh: 她看書時，柔軟的沙發將她整個包住。

examples.en: A coil of rope lay on the deck.
examples.zh: 甲板上放著一捲繩子。

examples.en: The heater has a metal coil inside.
examples.zh: 這台電暖器裡面有一圈金屬線圈。

examples.en: He wore a coil of wire around his arm.
examples.zh: 他的手臂上繞著一圈電線。

examples.en: The snake coiled itself around a branch.
examples.zh: 那條蛇盤繞在一根樹枝上。

examples.en: She coiled the garden hose and put it away.
examples.zh: 她把園藝水管捲起來收好。

examples.en: Smoke coiled slowly up from the chimney.
examples.zh: 煙從煙囪裡緩緩盤旋而上。

examples.en: My birthday coincides with the school festival this year.
examples.zh: 我今年的生日剛好與校慶同一天。

examples.en: Their opinions rarely coincide with each other.
examples.zh: 他們的意見很少一致。

examples.en: The sale will coincide with the opening of the new store.
examples.zh: 特賣會將與新店開幕同時舉行。

examples.en: She collected stamps from many countries.
examples.zh: 她收集了許多國家的郵票。

examples.en: The teacher collected our homework on Friday.
examples.zh: 老師在星期五收了我們的功課。

examples.en: He collected his package from the post office.
examples.zh: 他去郵局領了他的包裹。

examples.en: She stayed calm and collected during the interview.
examples.zh: 她在面試中保持冷靜沉著。

examples.en: This book is a collected set of his best stories.
examples.zh: 這本書是他最佳短篇故事的合集。

examples.en: The collected data will be shared with the class.
examples.zh: 蒐集到的資料將與全班分享。

examples.en: Two bikes collided at the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 兩輛腳踏車在街角相撞。

examples.en: The ball collided with the window and broke it.
examples.zh: 球撞上窗戶並把它撞破了。

examples.en: Their schedules collide on Thursday afternoons.
examples.zh: 他們的行程在星期四下午相衝突。

examples.en: The colonel greeted the soldiers at the gate.
examples.zh: 上校在大門口迎接士兵們。

examples.en: My grandfather retired as a colonel in the army.
examples.zh: 我爺爺以陸軍上校的身分退役。

examples.en: The colonel gave a short speech at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 上校在典禮上發表了簡短的演說。

senses.zh: 捲土重來；東山再起；機智的回嘴

examples.en: The singer made a comeback after five quiet years.
examples.zh: 這位歌手沉寂五年後東山再起。

examples.en: Our team staged a great comeback in the second half.
examples.zh: 我們隊在下半場上演了精彩的逆轉。

examples.en: She had a clever comeback ready for his joke.
examples.zh: 她對他的玩笑準備好了一句機智的回應。

senses.zh: 落差；地位下降；令人失望的事

examples.en: Moving into a tiny room was a big comedown for him.
examples.zh: 搬進小房間對他來說是一大落差。

examples.en: After the exciting trip, school felt like a comedown.
examples.zh: 精彩的旅行之後，上學讓人覺得很失落。

examples.en: Losing the title was a real comedown for the team.
examples.zh: 失去冠軍頭銜對球隊而言是真正的挫敗。

examples.en: The town built a statue to commemorate the founder.
examples.zh: 小鎮蓋了一座雕像來紀念創辦人。

examples.en: We held a ceremony to commemorate the school's hundredth year.
examples.zh: 我們舉辦典禮來紀念學校一百週年。

examples.en: This stamp was made to commemorate the Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 這枚郵票是為紀念奧運而發行的。

examples.en: The meeting will commence at nine o'clock sharp.
examples.zh: 會議將在九點整開始。

examples.en: Classes commence in early September.
examples.zh: 課程在九月初開始。

examples.en: The company plans to commence work on the bridge next month.
examples.zh: 公司計畫下個月開始動工建橋。

examples.en: The principal commended the students for their hard work.
examples.zh: 校長表揚學生們的努力。

examples.en: The manager commended her on the successful project.
examples.zh: 經理稱讚她成功完成專案。

examples.en: I commend this restaurant to anyone who loves seafood.
examples.zh: 我向任何愛吃海鮮的人推薦這家餐廳。

examples.en: The police commissioner spoke to reporters this morning.
examples.zh: 警政署長今天早上對記者發表談話。

examples.en: A new commissioner was chosen to lead the sports league.
examples.zh: 運動聯盟選出了一位新的會長來領導。

examples.en: The commissioner approved the plan for the new park.
examples.zh: 委員核准了新公園的計畫。

examples.en: The apartment has a communal garden for all residents.
examples.zh: 這棟公寓有供所有住戶使用的公共花園。

examples.en: Students share a communal kitchen on each floor.
examples.zh: 學生們每層樓共用一間廚房。

examples.en: The village holds a communal dinner every autumn.
examples.zh: 村子每年秋天都會舉辦社區聚餐。

examples.en: Many elderly people need companionship more than medicine.
examples.zh: 許多老人需要的陪伴比藥物更多。

examples.en: The dog gave him companionship during the long winter.
examples.zh: 在漫長的冬天裡，這隻狗給了他陪伴。

examples.en: She joined the club for friendship and companionship.
examples.zh: 她加入社團是為了友誼與陪伴。

examples.en: The train compartment was clean and quiet.
examples.zh: 火車的車廂又乾淨又安靜。

examples.en: Put your bag in the overhead compartment.
examples.zh: 把你的包包放進頭頂的置物櫃。

examples.en: The fridge has a separate compartment for vegetables.
examples.zh: 冰箱有一個專門放蔬菜的隔層。

senses.zh: 令人信服的；引人入勝的；強烈的

examples.en: She gave a compelling reason for changing the plan.
examples.zh: 她為更改計畫提出了令人信服的理由。

examples.en: The movie tells a compelling story about friendship.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述了一個引人入勝的友誼故事。

examples.en: There is compelling evidence that exercise improves sleep.
examples.zh: 有強而有力的證據顯示運動能改善睡眠。

examples.en: Two competing companies sell similar phones.
examples.zh: 兩家互相競爭的公司販售類似的手機。

examples.en: The competing teams shook hands after the game.
examples.zh: 相互競爭的隊伍在比賽後握了手。

examples.en: She had competing offers from two schools.
examples.zh: 她收到兩所學校互相競爭的錄取通知。

examples.en: Twenty students are competing for the top prize.
examples.zh: 二十名學生正在爭奪首獎。

examples.en: Our school is competing in the national contest.
examples.zh: 我們學校正在參加全國比賽。

examples.en: Small shops are competing with large supermarkets.
examples.zh: 小商店正在與大型超市競爭。

examples.en: The bike frame is made of a composite material.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是以複合材料製成的。

examples.en: The report gives a composite picture of the city's growth.
examples.zh: 這份報告呈現了這座城市成長的綜合面貌。

examples.en: The police released a composite sketch of the thief.
examples.zh: 警方公布了嫌犯的合成畫像。

examples.en: The panel is a composite of glass and plastic.
examples.zh: 這塊面板是玻璃與塑膠的合成物。

examples.en: This score is a composite of three different tests.
examples.zh: 這個分數是三項不同測驗的綜合結果。

examples.en: Engineers use a light composite to build the boat.
examples.zh: 工程師用輕量的複合材料來製造這艘船。

examples.en: You can compress the files to save space.
examples.zh: 你可以壓縮檔案來節省空間。

examples.en: She compressed her clothes into a small suitcase.
examples.zh: 她把衣服塞進一個小行李箱。

examples.en: The teacher compressed the long story into one paragraph.
examples.zh: 老師把長篇故事濃縮成一段。

examples.en: The nurse put a cold compress on his forehead.
examples.zh: 護理師把冷敷布敷在他的額頭上。

examples.en: A warm compress can ease the pain.
examples.zh: 熱敷可以減輕疼痛。

examples.en: She held a damp compress against her sore eye.
examples.zh: 她把濕敷布按在疼痛的眼睛上。
